name: Nagaregawa Kohane
source:
A heroine who listens to your words slowly. I don't mean that she listens to you slowly, but seriously.

She can be difficult to deal with and insists on casual assertions.

In the real world, she is excellent. She is a firm person. She is a healer. However, he refuses to have her image defined or be defined by her appearance.

Nickname Online: MONNBRUN
Occupation: Student / Class Committee
Comprehension Skills: She approaches everything seriously.
Three Sizes: Secret / Bust size is actually 90 cm.

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/online/character/kohane.htm]official site[/url]]
